providers.use: background fill inside a 4 px band around the cable alpha and its cast shadow
transparent cable redraw guided by a SAM 3 mask, registered back into the scene (affine ECC + smoothed optical flow)
unlit neon crown, edit guided by the original tube centre lines; only the crown pixels are used

cutoutMethod: cable body and battery clip from the registered redraw; machine plug head kept from original pixels so it sits in its socket, cross-faded into the redraw between y=566 and y=580
backgroundMethod: original outside the repair band; provider fill inside it; empty machine socket (plug hole above a recessed plate) redrawn where the plug was
machineOffMethod: deterministic relight of the background pixels: light sources become unlit dark glass, red light spill removed, reel window not backlit; crown tubes from the guided edit
notes: Background is the powered machine with the cable removed. Layer order: background, machine-off (when unpowered), cable. SVG embedding keeps every image local and self-contained.
